milestone: W16 slice 3 — a SCIM deprovision reaches every door

checks.check: admin login is admin
team tier raised for the drill
member invited
invite redeemed
SCIM token minted
the raw token is shown once
and the list carries no secret
a user session token does not open the SCIM door
SCIM list answers
both seats are visible
the member is active before the drill writes
meta.location points at this surface
the userName filter finds one seat
a stale If-Match is refused with 412
and nothing changed behind it
deprovision accepted
and the resource says so
the etag moved
identity /me refuses the deprovisioned member
the shared dependency refuses it too (401, not 404)
the store shows the seat disabled
a fresh login is refused too
and the refusal names the seat, not the password
and this team's session rows are gone (teams_api convention)
the mutation is audited as a deprovision by the token, not a person
and the audit row names the credential that wrote it
reactivation accepted
and the seat is live again
a new session can be minted again
and it works at the shared door
the last admin cannot be deprovisioned
and the refusal is a SCIM error object, not our envelope
the admin seat is untouched
an attribute this service does not own is refused, not ignored
the SCIM token is revoked
and a revoked credential writes nothing

notes: no secret appears in this file: the SCIM token is shown once in the mint
response and never stored, only its SHA-256 is.
the member's session token was issued BEFORE the PATCH; nothing else
was changed by hand between acceptance and the 401s.
